text:
hana (eng): heads up - we had a payroll vendor cutover last month and my 401k match didn't show on the April payment. I elected HSA and 401k during open enrollment but April shows 0 employer match and no HSA deferral. Did the vendor cutover drop my elections?
ryan (People Ops): sorry you're seeing that. short answer: vendor cutovers sometimes require election re-syncs. can you share the paystub dates? also did you have any payroll adjustments in april?
hana (eng): pay period 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-15 was run on 2026-04-16 (first post-cutover run). no manual adjustments from me. payroll journal id PJ-4432 on stub.
marta (Benefits): adding context from benefits: during the cutover we had a mapping issue for some HRIS ids; if your HRIS id changed or wasn't in the initial file the vendor defaulted elections to 'none'. we need: (1) copy of stub, (2) enrollment confirmation, (3) HRIS id. with that we can request an off-cycle employer match and push missed HSA deferral as a pre-tax off-cycle if within vendor window.
payroll-bot: AUTO: required off-cycle inputs: EnrollmentConfirmation.pdf, Paystub_PJ-4432.pdf, EmployeeDeferralExport.csv. Sample CSV format:
``nHRIS_ID,pay_period_start,pay_period_end,employee_deferral,employer_match
H2345,2026-04-01,2026-04-15,200.00,50.00
```n
ryan (People Ops): hana please upload the stub and enrollment files to the HR ticket. FYI we'll need manager approval to post employer money off-cycle.
kevin (manager): i approve the off-cycle employer match posting for hana. also approve pushing the HSA deferral if vendor allows pre-tax posting.
marta (Benefits): vendor note: plan codes - 401k PLAN-RED-401 (7102), HSA HST-3301. vendor cutover SLA: off-cycle acceptance window is 45 days from affected payroll run. if we miss that window vendor may require manual employee contribution instead. also note: if employee had an outstanding 401k loan, off-cycle employer posting will not be applied until loan repayment allocations are processed by vendor; this can delay posting to vested account.
vendor-ops-bot: received off-cycle request. validation flags: HRIS_ID match - FAIL (HRIS_ID in EnrollmentConfirmation: H2345; HRIS_ID in payroll file: H-2345). Please use identical HRIS formatting.
hana (eng): ah shoot - my HRIS id has a dash in some systems. i'll correct the HRIS id to H2345 in the enrollment doc and re-upload. thanks for catching that.
ryan (People Ops): great. once you re-upload i'll kick to payroll. expect vendor posting ETA 2 pay cycles after acceptance. we'll include a note about loan handling to ensure vendor clears employer contribution to available balance once loan allocation resolves.
marta (Benefits): if you want the HSA deferral as pre-tax, we need the off-cycle request now; otherwise employee can make an after-tax contribution and claim on taxes. happy to model the tax diff.
hana (eng): please do pre-tax off-cycle. re-uploading corrected enrollment now. thanks all. :pray:
